exact_ast_source:
def shift(probability, prior=0.02, sample_prior=PRIOR):
    return expit(logit(np.clip(probability, 1e-06, 1 - 1e-06)) + logit(prior) - logit(sample_prior))

def measure(frame, selected, prior=0.02, cost=1.0, success=0.2, proxy=None):
    y = frame.y.to_numpy()
    v = frame.value.to_numpy() if proxy is None else np.asarray(proxy)
    w = weights(y, prior)
    pd_ = shift(frame.p_s.to_numpy(), prior)
    selected = np.asarray(selected, dtype=float)
    contacts = float(np.sum(w * selected))
    actual_churners = float(np.sum(w * selected * y))
    actual_value = float(np.sum(w * selected * y * v))
    expected_churners = float(np.sum(w * selected * pd_))
    expected_value = float(np.sum(w * selected * pd_ * v))
    gross = actual_value * success * 6 * 0.6
    return {'raw_count': int(np.count_nonzero(selected)), 'contacts': contacts, 'achieved_contact_fraction': contacts / 100000, 'mean_value': float(np.sum(w * selected * v) / contacts) if contacts else 0.0, 'sample_precision': float(np.sum(selected * y) / np.sum(selected)) if np.sum(selected) else 0.0, 'deployment_precision': actual_churners / contacts if contacts else 0.0, 'actual_churners': actual_churners, 'actual_value': actual_value, 'value_recall': actual_value / float(np.sum(w * y * v)), 'model_expected_churners': expected_churners, 'model_expected_value': expected_value, 'model_expected_net': expected_value * success * 6 * 0.6 - contacts * cost - 5000, 'actual_gross': gross, 'net': gross - contacts * cost - 5000, 'break_even_contact_cost': (gross - 5000) / contacts if contacts else None, 'break_even_success': (contacts * cost + 5000) / (actual_value * 6 * 0.6) if actual_value else None, 'observed_expected_churn_ratio': actual_churners / expected_churners if expected_churners else None}
